# R5.18 — Persist retained context and replay its selection (seq 188)

Implements contract `docs/tickets/188_R5.18__retained.md`, **as amended
2026-11-03** by the scoped split review — verdict **AMEND** (ruling
commit `b9ec0189`; review record
`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.18-split-review.md`). Offline-only;
USD 0; merges OPERATOR.

**Deviation (conspicuous):** ~1,691 changed source/test lines vs the
≤700 split trigger (~2.4×). The worker stopped correctly at the trigger
(checkpoint `f073775c`); the scoped review found `retained_selection/1`
is one admitted atomic unit — Packet B B.2 binds persist + rebuild
equality to ONE seam/owner (hh-context), the proposed cut lands
persisted-but-unverifiable records (the B.10 rejection), AC clauses
span the cut, and both proposed legs would still exceed. Accepted as a
recorded Deviation per the Amended 2026-11-03 ruling — never a
precedent for unmeasured growth.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-context/src/retained.rs` (new, ~1,114 lines) —
  `retained_selection/1`: `RetainedSelection` (the persisted
  `selection` member) + `SelectionInput` — **the shared input
  representation the prepared call consumes** (R5.19 leg): recorded
  `policy{variant_ref, parameters}` + the assessed envelope
  (trigger/window_cap/needed/target_fraction_ppm/occupancy) + legal
  cut points + flattened join rows (context_item_id, candidate_id,
  slot_id, retention, source_seq, tokens, paired_with, batch_id,
  tool{capability, invocation_ref}) — rebuild needs no ledger read.
  Canonical `to_json`/`from_json` over the crate codec
  (integer-canonical, `reject_unknown`, closed shape).
  `replay_selection` rebuilds `CompactInput` and re-runs the
  production `assess` + recorded variant's `propose`/`execute` — no
  parallel selection logic; `verify_selection` → `SelectionVerdict`
  {`Reproduced`, `Diverged`, `Refused`} over `SelectionRefusal`
  (UnknownPolicy, DuplicateIds, ProtectedGroup, OrphanPair,
  OrphanBatch, MissingCompletionAge, TriggerAbsent, UnknownItem,
  Malformed) and `SelectionOutcome` (Untriggered, Applied,
  Ineffective, Failed) with `via_fallback` kept distinct.
- `crates/hh-context/src/compact.rs` —
  `CompactionStrategy::selection_parameters()` (default `{}`;
  `ClearToolResults` emits `{capabilities, older_than,
  completed_invocations}` — the completion-age join it consumed);
  `CompactionRecord.selection` minted at every `mint_record` site,
  including the applied fallback leg's own parameters.
- `crates/hh-context/src/events.rs` — `compaction_completed` emits the
  additive `selection` member (durable/wire compatible: payload rows
  gain a member; no class or generated artifact changes).
- `crates/hh-context/src/compact_family.rs`, `lib.rs` — model-owned
  call sites pass `{}`; public re-exports.
- `crates/hh-context/tests/r5_18.rs` (~502 lines) — the six-test
  battery (fails-without: `retained` module + `selection` member are
  compile-red/absent at base `3c07e282`).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0396` — the owned landing decisions; ADR index +
  REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BACKLOG.csv BL-47 sources home.
- `docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_evidence-coverage.md` — dated
  contributing note names seq 188 (AC-3).
- `docs/build/runs/R5.18.md` — run ledger (gate verbatim, guard reads,
  cap-trigger STOP + ruling, evidence).
